component.name: jgroups-raft
component.title: JGroups raft
component.description: Append data to the replicated log of a JGroups-raft cluster, and receive the leader and follower role changes of the local member.
component.label: clustering,messaging

channelProperties.description: The JGroups XML configuration of the JChannel that each endpoint creates, as a file, a URL or a classpath resource. If not set, the raft.xml in the camel-jgroups-raft JAR is used, and a WARN is logged when an endpoint starts. That raft.xml is a sample for development and tests: it uses UDP multicast without authentication or encryption, and lists A as the only RAFT member. In production, set your own configuration, with AUTH and SYM_ENCRYPT or ASYM_ENCRYPT, and the members of the cluster in the members attribute of RAFT. Not used when the raftHandle option is set.

raftHandle.description: To use a custom org.jgroups.raft.RaftHandle for all the endpoints of this component. When set, the raftId, channelProperties and stateMachine options are not used. The component closes its channel and its log when the component stops.

raftId.description: The Raft ID of this member, which also names the JChannel. A member whose ID is not in the members attribute of RAFT in the channel configuration is a Learner, which does not vote. If not set, the raft_id of the channel configuration is used. Not used when the raftHandle option is set.

stateMachine.description: The org.jgroups.raft.StateMachine that applies the committed log entries, for the RaftHandle that each endpoint creates. The default NopStateMachine ignores the entries and returns an empty byte array. Not used when the raftHandle option is set.

bridgeErrorHandler.label: consumer
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelJGroupsRaftLogSize.label: consumer
CamelJGroupsRaftLogSize.description: The number of entries in the Raft log of this member. The consumer sets it on each event, and the producer after each set.

CamelJGroupsRaftCommitIndex.label: consumer
CamelJGroupsRaftCommitIndex.description: The commit index: the index of the last log entry that is committed. The consumer sets it on each event, and the producer after each set.

CamelJGroupsRaftCurrentTerm.label: consumer
CamelJGroupsRaftCurrentTerm.description: The current Raft term of this member. The consumer sets it on each event, and the producer after each set.

CamelJGroupsRaftIsLeader.label: consumer
CamelJGroupsRaftIsLeader.description: Whether this member is the Raft leader. The consumer sets it on each event, and the producer after each set.

CamelJGroupsRaftLastApplied.label: consumer
CamelJGroupsRaftLastApplied.description: The index of the last log entry that this member applied to its state machine. The consumer sets it on each event, and the producer after each set.

CamelJGroupsRaftLeaderAddress.label: consumer
CamelJGroupsRaftLeaderAddress.description: The JGroups address of the Raft leader, or null if no leader is known. The consumer sets it on each event, and the producer after each set.

CamelJGroupsRaftRaftId.label: consumer
CamelJGroupsRaftRaftId.description: The Raft ID of this member. The consumer sets it on each event, and the producer after each set.

CamelJGroupsRaftEventType.label: consumer
CamelJGroupsRaftEventType.description: The role that this member changed to: LEADER, or FOLLOWER (also for a Learner). The consumer sets it only with enableRoleChangeEvents.

CamelJGroupsRaftSetOffset.label: producer
CamelJGroupsRaftSetOffset.description: The offset in the body byte array of the data to set. Used only together with CamelJGroupsRaftSetLength: if either is missing, the whole body is set.

CamelJGroupsRaftSetLength.label: producer
CamelJGroupsRaftSetLength.description: The number of bytes of the body to set, from CamelJGroupsRaftSetOffset. Used only together with CamelJGroupsRaftSetOffset: if either is missing, the whole body is set.

CamelJGroupsRaftSetTimeout.label: producer
CamelJGroupsRaftSetTimeout.description: How long the producer waits for the set to complete, in the unit of CamelJGroupsRaftSetTimeUnit, before it fails with a TimeoutException. Used only when CamelJGroupsRaftSetOffset, CamelJGroupsRaftSetLength and CamelJGroupsRaftSetTimeUnit are set too; otherwise the producer waits without a timeout.

CamelJGroupsRaftSetTimeUnit.label: producer
CamelJGroupsRaftSetTimeUnit.description: The java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit of CamelJGroupsRaftSetTimeout. Used only when CamelJGroupsRaftSetOffset, CamelJGroupsRaftSetLength and CamelJGroupsRaftSetTimeout are set too.

consumerOut.description: No body: an event for each change of the role of this member (only with enableRoleChangeEvents), with LEADER or FOLLOWER in the CamelJGroupsRaftEventType header and the state of the raft in the other headers

producerIn.description: The bytes to set() in the replicated log: a byte array, or text, a stream or a file converted to bytes. A null body is skipped: nothing is set. A Map, a List, a number or a POJO has no conversion to bytes and fails with an InvalidPayloadException

producerOut.description: The byte array the state machine returns for the set (an empty array with the default NopStateMachine), with the state of the raft in the headers. A null body is left as it was

clusterName.description: The name of the JGroups cluster that the channel of the RaftHandle connects to. All the members of the Raft cluster use the same name.

channelProperties.description: The JGroups XML configuration of the JChannel that the endpoint creates, as a file, a URL or a classpath resource. If not set, the channelProperties of the component is used, else the raft.xml in the camel-jgroups-raft JAR, and a WARN is logged when the endpoint starts. That raft.xml is a sample for development and tests: it uses UDP multicast without authentication or encryption, and lists A as the only RAFT member. In production, set your own configuration, with AUTH and SYM_ENCRYPT or ASYM_ENCRYPT, and the members of the cluster in the members attribute of RAFT. Not used when the raftHandle option is set.

raftHandle.description: To use a custom org.jgroups.raft.RaftHandle for this endpoint instead of the raftHandle of the component. When set, the raftId, channelProperties and stateMachine options are not used. The component closes its channel and its log when the component stops.

raftId.description: The Raft ID of this member, which also names the JChannel. A member whose ID is not in the members attribute of RAFT in the channel configuration is a Learner, which does not vote. If not set, the raftId of the component is used, else the raft_id of the channel configuration. Not used when the raftHandle option is set.

stateMachine.description: The org.jgroups.raft.StateMachine that applies the committed log entries, for the RaftHandle that the endpoint creates. If not set, the stateMachine of the component is used. The default NopStateMachine ignores the entries and returns an empty byte array. Not used when the raftHandle option is set.

enableRoleChangeEvents.label: consumer
enableRoleChangeEvents.description: Whether the consumer routes an exchange each time this member becomes the leader or a follower, with LEADER or FOLLOWER in the CamelJGroupsRaftEventType header. A Learner counts as a follower. If false, the consumer only connects the channel and routes no exchanges.

By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exceptionHandler.label: consumer,advanced
exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.label: consumer,advanced
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.
